content.short: XY Finance is a cross-chain swap aggregator that connects multiple bridge protocols for the best execution on any cross-chain token transfer.
content.description: XY Finance is a cross-chain swap aggregator comparing rates and liquidity across multiple bridge partners to find the optimal route for any cross-chain token transfer  considering fees, speed, and security simultaneously. Rather than relying on a single bridge, XY Finance intelligently routes transfers across its integrated bridge network. Supporting Mantle and dozens of other chains, XY Finance provides a unified, optimal cross-chain swap experience.
content.meta: XY Finance aggregates multiple bridges for optimal cross-chain swaps to and from Mantle. Discover XY Finance on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
